key_insight: ViBMR introduces a large-scale dataset pairing multi-sequence brain MRI with routine Vietnamese radiology reports to support report-generation research in a low-resource clinical language.
clinical_relevance: The dataset could support research toward reducing radiologists’ reporting workload, but the abstract does not establish clinical readiness.
method: Pair brain MRI studies with routine Vietnamese clinical reports.
Include T1, T2, FLAIR, and contrast-enhanced T1 sequences.
Evaluate representative medical vision-language models, multi-sequence inputs, and feature aggregation strategies.
evidence_signal: ViBMR contains 3,649 patients and 11,875 MRI series; the abstract describes comprehensive baseline evaluation but reports no quantitative performance results.
watch_item: Clinical accuracy and generalizability require further validation before deployment.
paper_title: ViBMR: A Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Brain MRI Dataset and Comprehensive Evaluation for Vietnamese Radiology Report Generation
